newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow car bomb kills ultra-nationalist aide.
newsitem.headline: Moscow car bomb kills ultra-nationalist aide.

text.p: A car bomb on Friday killed a parliamentary aide to Vladimir Zhirinovsky's ultra-nationist party, police said.
The incident happened on one of Moscow's main boulevards at about 1 p.m. on Friday when a Mercedes automobile was blwon up by a bomb under the driver's seat, a police spokesman said.
The aide, Anatoly Frantskevich, worked for a member of parliament from Zhirinovsky's Liberal Democratic Party. A second man in the car was badly hurt and taken to hospital.
Police said it was the fifth killing of aides to the party's members of parliament in recent years.
